questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Neither he nor his friends _____ present at the party.
questions.explanation: When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', verb agrees with the nearest subject (friends -> were).
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Either Ram or Shyam _____ done this work.
questions.explanation: Singular subjects joined by 'either... or' take singular verb 'has'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: The Quality of these mangoes _____ not good.
questions.explanation: Subject is singular noun 'Quality', so verb is 'is'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Bread and butter _____ a wholesome breakfast.
questions.explanation: Two items forming a single idea take a singular verb 'is'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Slow and steady _____ the race.
questions.explanation: Singular proverb concept takes 'wins'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Fire and water _____ not agree.
questions.explanation: Two distinct elements take plural verb 'do'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Mathematics _____ an interesting subject.
questions.explanation: Names of subjects ending in 's' take singular verb 'is'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Forty miles _____ a long distance to walk.
questions.explanation: A single quantity or distance takes singular verb 'is'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Each of the boys _____ given a prize.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is distributive singular and takes singular verb 'was'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: One of my friends _____ a famous doctor.
questions.explanation: 'One of + plural noun' takes singular verb 'is'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct modal verb: We _____ respect our elders.
questions.explanation: 'Should' or 'ought to' expresses moral duty and advice.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct modal verb: _____ I come in, Sir?
questions.explanation: 'May' is used for formal permission.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct modal verb: Work hard lest you _____ fail.
questions.explanation: The conjunction 'lest' is strictly followed by 'should'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct modal verb: If I were a bird, I _____ fly in the sky.
questions.explanation: Unreal conditional clauses take 'would' in main clause.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct modal verb: You _____ not worry, everything is fine.
questions.explanation: 'Need not' expresses absence of necessity.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct modal verb: _____ God bless you!
questions.explanation: Optative wishes begin with 'May'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct modal verb: He _____ swim across the river when he was young.
questions.explanation: Past ability is expressed by 'could'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct modal verb: Candidates _____ answer all questions.
questions.explanation: Compulsion or rule is expressed by 'must'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence form: If it rains, we _____ at home.
questions.explanation: First conditional takes simple present in 'if' clause and 'will + V1' in main clause.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence form: If he had worked hard, he _____ the exam.
questions.explanation: Third conditional takes 'had + V3' in 'if' clause and 'would have + V3' in main clause.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: He is _____ honorable gentleman.
questions.explanation: Honorable starts with silent 'h' and vowel sound, taking 'an'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: She plays _____ piano very well.
questions.explanation: Musical instruments take definite article 'the'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: _____ Holy Bible is a sacred book.
questions.explanation: Sacred scriptures take definite article 'The'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: Copper is _____ useful metal.
questions.explanation: Useful starts with consonant sound /juː/, so it takes 'a'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: He returned after _____ hour.
questions.explanation: Hour starts with silent 'h' and vowel sound /aʊə/, so it takes 'an'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: The boy said, 'Hurrah! We have won the match.'
options: The boy exclaimed with joy that they had won the match.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: She said, 'Alas! I am ruined.'

She exclaimed with sorrow that she was ruined.

questions.q: Change to active voice: 'The work was completed by them.'
questions.explanation: Past passive 'was completed' converts to simple past active 'completed'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to active voice: 'English is spoken all over the world.'
options: People speak English all over the world.
questions.explanation: Present passive with omitted agent converts to 'People speak...'.
questions.subject: English
